meta_description: Architecture, security posture and compliance evidence for Dataq Forge — Data & Lakehouse Engineering Platform from Dataq Software.

blocks.x: A no-theater description of Dataq Forge — Architecture & Trust: what ships first, what it touches at operational stores, how it is verified, and the per workflow metric we commit to moving against baseline.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (medallion architecture with data contracts, tag-based access control with lineage, Kafka/Flink with exactly-once semantics); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (feature store, vector search, retrieval services, workload isolation and showback); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.
